name: Exception_Control1
_about: Field added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (03 Fulfillment / 06 Kanban, Scoreboard and SO Report, RW-R4: rework rate split by rework type and fault origin; 05 Shared Engines / 05 Exceptions, EX-2: fault_origin options). Edited inline in the Exception Control widget, next to Rework and Status; optional, filled in whenever known (same as Rework). Read by app/fulfillment/scoreboard.py for the rework-rate-by-origin breakdown.

fields.name: Fault_Origin
fields.label: Fault Origin
fields.helpText: Where the defect was caused, not where it was found (EX-2). Optional; blank counts as "Not chosen yet" on the Scoreboard.
